models_evaluated: eight commercial and open-source multimodal LLMs (others not named in abstract)

links.outcome: Carbohydrate estimation error from meal photographs relative to the insulin-dosing-relevant threshold
links.effect: Carbohydrate MAE 13.3 g (95% CI 12.4-14.3); only 57% of meals within ±10 g, the threshold relevant for insulin dosing in type 1 diabetes.
links.quote: The carbohydrate mean absolute error was 13.3 g (95% CI 12.4--14.3), and only 57% of meals were within +/- 10 g, a clinically relevant threshold for insulin dosing in type 1 diabetes.

unlisted_practices: Chain-of-thought prompting to improve nutrient estimation (did not consistently improve performance)
Including sizing reference markers in photographs (did not improve accuracy)
Integrating visual assessment with additional contextual information for dietary monitoring

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking of commercial and open-source multimodal LLMs for image-based dietary assessment and nutrient estimation in diabetes using the SNAPMe dataset.
